latch: Legacy: two accumulating positive pairs, held while close/proximal. Fresh: two consecutive positive pairs, expire after 0.5 s without confirmation; closed unverified remains unknown.
motion_rule: Same prior thresholds: nearby within40px; EEF movement>.3px; object movement>.2px; difference<max(3px,0.7*EEFmovement).
truth: Read by scorer after all three input variants; never provided to detector. Score bilateral contact separately from contact+10mm lift.
controls: frozen initial RGB with real telemetry
fixed initial EEF position with real RGB and aperture
scope: Eight reused development/source action traces. Component diagnostic; not unseen-scene performance, metric object-pose reconstruction, phone retargeting or control qualification.
